starting-out-inspecting-the-dwarf.player: How do I protect you I wonder....

starting-out-inspecting-the-dwarf.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-dwarf.text: To protect our short angry friend from the culinaromancer's magics, I suggest that you seek out his father within the mountain tunnel that he guards.

starting-out-inspecting-the-dwarf.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-dwarf.text: His fondness for rock cakes could prove key in freeing him.

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember how I defeated him can you?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

steps.player: That dwarf... I somehow can't remember how I managed to save him...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: The dwarf? Oh, yeah, I think that was an easy one, didn't you say?

steps.player: I did? Er, I did.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: You went to see his dad in the tunnels under white wolf mountain, and then got some rock cakes, if I remember rightly.

steps.player: Oh yeah... I remember now...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.speaker: An old Dwarf
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.text: I have absolutely no clue what you are on about. Sit down, catch your breath and explain please!

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.player: Ok. Your son, the one who guards the tunnel entrance?

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.speaker: An old Dwarf
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.text: Oh aye. Good lad he is.

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.player: Well he's at a special meeting and he's frozen by the culinaromancer!

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.speaker: An old Dwarf
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.text: Ok... you lost me again. I just got back from visitin' him up top, he's fine.

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.speaker: An old Dwarf
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.text: Oh that. No no, he's quite ok. That was last week.

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.player: I need your rock cakes to free him from it.

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.speaker: Rohak
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-an-.text: You're delusional. Never would old Rohak give away his special recipe, not for all the golden nectar from the Rising Sun!

below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-roh.speaker: Rohak
below-white-wolf-mountain-talking-to-roh.text: I would never give away me special rock cake recipe, not for all the golden nectar from the Rising Sun!

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-emily.speaker: Emily
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-emily.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

steps.player: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Erm... they like it?

steps.player: No no no... I mean what kind of ale do they drink?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Well I know for sure that they enjoy my special recipe.

steps.player: Oh? Would you tell me?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: And lose money? I think not!

options.text: I could offer you some in return, how about 100 gold?

steps.player: I could offer you some in return, how about 100 gold?

steps.text: If the player does not have a chocolate bar or a plain pizza in backpack:

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Sorry, no deal, that wouldn't even cover my expenses.
If the player has a chocolate bar in their backpack:

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: You have CHOCOLATE in your pack, I can smell it! 50 gold and chocolate and the secret is yours!!
If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money on me.

steps.text: If the player has enough money:

steps.player: You have a deal. Here you go...

steps.text: You hand over the chocolate and money.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love, I think they're genetically attracted to gold.

steps.player: Sorry, no deal.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Your loss! Next customer please!
If the player has a plain pizza in their backpack:

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Welll... maybe... look.. I'm on duty here at the bar so I can't get anything to eat, I could murder a pizza.

steps.player: I just happen to have some on me.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Pizza and 100 gold and the secret is yours!
If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money on me.

steps.text: If the player has enough money:

steps.player: You have a deal. Here you go...

steps.text: You hand over the pizza and money.

steps.player: Sorry, no deal.

options.text: I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: But I don't have the money on me. I'll have to come back.

steps.text: If the player has enough money and does not have the Ring of Charos(a) equipped:

steps.player: I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: You sure you haven't got anymore?

steps.player: Just 200... honest!

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Hand it over then and I'll tell you the secret.
You hand over 200 gold.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love, I think they're genetically attracted to gold.
If the player has enough money and the Ring of Charos(a) equipped:

steps.player: I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: You're a good person... for you, 150 and you have a deal.
You hand over 150 gold.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love, I think they're genetically attracted to gold.

options.text: (Persuade)I'm really quite trustworthy once you get to know me.
options.condition: With a Ring of Charos(a) equipped

steps.player: Oh go on, I'm really quite trustworthy once you get to know me.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love. I think they're genetically attracted to gold.

steps.player: Thanks.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: What...what am I saying? I just gave you the secret!

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-kaylee.speaker: Kaylee
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-kaylee.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-tina.speaker: Tina
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-tina.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-emily-again.speaker: Emily
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-emily-again.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

steps.player: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Oh it's you again. Forgotten the secret already?

steps.player: No... I just... misplaced it.

steps.speaker: Emily
steps.text: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love, I think they're genetically attracted to gold.

steps.player: Thanks, I won't forg...err... misplace it, this time.

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-kaylee-agai.speaker: Kaylee
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-kaylee-agai.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

the-golden-nectar-talking-to-tina-again.speaker: Tina
the-golden-nectar-talking-to-tina-again.text: Heya! What can I get you?

options.text: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.text: You hand the ale to the dwarf who slurps it with a noise of a thousand seals celebrating a rain of fish.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.text: Is that what I think it is?

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.text: That's from the Rising Sun, the barmaid there will never tell me the recipe she uses. It's divine!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.text: No! I shwears I'll never tell...
The dwarf nurses the very last drops of the pint as if he'd really like more.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-with.player: I think you deserve another pint.
I'm sure another pint will go down nicely.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.text: Ahhh, yer me besht mate... mate.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.player: You're a good friend Rohak, do you think you could do me a favour?

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.text: Fer you [player name]? Fer you I'd... I'd... shlide down a shlope of thishtlesh wif no 'elmet on!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.player: I don't need you to do that ... friend. Just something as simple as baking me some of your wonderful rock cakes. Hmm? For your good friend?

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.text: Fer you! Anyfin'! Fer a price of course!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.player: Good. I'm sure I have some gold somewhere!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.player: How much gold do you want to make the cake?

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.text: WHAT?! That wasn't a dream? Oh my aching head...

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.player: No, not a dream, you agreed to make me your special rock cake, for a fee.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.text: If the player doesn't have enough money

steps.player: Maybe I should have some more money with me, he did say he'd want payment...

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-a-sober-ro.text: If the player has enough money

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: Also... you'll need to get the ingredients too. Milk, flour, egg and bowl of water, mind it's a bowl and not a dirty bucket.
You hand over 100 gold.

steps.player: You didn't say I'd have to run around... but ok! Milk, flour, egg, bowl of water....I'll be back!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.text: If the player has none of the items
If the player only has some of the items

steps.player: I have found some of the things you asked for:

steps.text: The following dialogue will change depending on what items the player has:

steps.player: [I have the egg/I don't have an egg, I'll look for some chickens], [I have a pot of flour/I don't have a pot of flour, but I'll investigate the windmills], [I have the bucket of milk/I don't have any milk but I'll check out the cows], [I have the bowl of water!/I don't have a bowl of water].

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: That's all well and good...but come back when you have all the ingredients. You're lucky Dwarves stick to their word else I might not make these cakes for you.

steps.player: Okay okay I'll get right on it! Keep your beard on!

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.player: N..n...nothing honest!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-agai.text: If the player has all the items

steps.player: I have all the items you asked for...is that it? I could make these!

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: No you couldn't, there's a special ingredient, but I'm not going to tell you what it is!

steps.player: Well... here's the ingredients anyway.

steps.text: You hand over the ingredients and watch the dwarf make the cake.
Rohak places the cake on the table.

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: There, as good as my word. Hot rock cakes to my special recipe.

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-afte.speaker: Rohak
getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-afte.text: Got any use out of that rock cake I made you [player name]?
If the player still has the rock cake

steps.player: Not yet but I will. I'm going to save your son.

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: I keep tellin you, he's fine!

getting-the-recipe-talking-to-rohak-afte.text: If the player has lost the rock cake

steps.player: I appear to have lost it somewhere, can you make me another?

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: I suppose so, but you'll need all the ingredients like last time.
If the player has none of the items
If the player only has some of the items

steps.player: I have found some of the things you asked for:

steps.text: If the player has all the items

steps.player: I lost the rock cake! But I have more ingredients, will you make me some more please?

steps.speaker: Rohak
steps.text: Oh... I suppose so. Give me the ingredients.
You hand over the ingredients and watch the dwarf make the cake.

getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.speaker: Aris
getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.text: STOP! What do you think you're doing!

getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.speaker: Aris
getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.text: You can't feed him red hot rock cakes! You'll kill him! Find a way to cool them down.

getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.player: Oh, ok, I'll find a way to cool them down then.

getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.speaker: Aris
getting-the-recipe-attempting-to-free-th.text: I hear there's a rather chilly reception on top of a rather icey mountain.

getting-the-recipe-cooling-the-rock-cake.text: The dying breath of the icefiend cools your hot rock cake.
Your ice gloves cool the hot rock cake as you pick it up.

finishing-up-freeing-the-dwarf.speaker: Aris
finishing-up-freeing-the-dwarf.text: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [number] council members left to protect!

jhrwBw.speaker: Rohak
jhrwBw.text: Have you forgotten the ingredients list? I'll need an egg, a pot of flour, a bucket of milk and a bowl of water to make these cakes for you.

jhrwBw.player: Ok, I'll see about getting them.
